core_change: A strategy is not always a fully verifiable optimization unit. Some strategies are construction steps inside a stage. Stage-level verification is executed only after all required subphases are resolved.

micro_strategy.description: A local construction/refinement step such as choosing BM/BN/BK, WM/WN, or TM/TN.
micro_strategy.verification: Only local field checks and dependency checks; no full semantic/resource verification unless enough fields are available.

stage.description: A complete GEMM construction phase such as Tiling, Layout, Mapping, Reordering, Vectorization, Pipeline, Epilogue.
stage.verification: Stage-level post verification after all required fields of the stage are resolved.

stage_plan.description: An ordered list of micro-strategies selected within one stage.

derived_fields.description: Fields computed after subphase completion, e.g. warps_per_block, threads_per_block, shared_memory_bytes.

strategy_object_required_changes.old_problem: preconditions/postconditions were attached to each strategy as if every strategy were independently and immediately verifiable.
